title: Low-Dose Naltrexone For ME/CFS: Dose-Finding
official: Low-dose Naltrexone (LDN) for the Treatment of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS): Dose-Finding
summary: This exploratory clinical trial tests low-dose naltrexone (LDN) for the treatment of Myalgic Encephalomyelitis/Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (ME/CFS). A remote trial approach is used, with eligibility open to the state of Alabama.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Between ages of 18 and 65
* Living in Alabama
* Meets ME-ICC criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* Abnormal hepatic function
* Abnormal renal function
* Abnormal complete blood count
* Evidence of active or chronic systemic infection
* A1C \> 9.0%
* Current opioid analgesic use
* Pregnant or plans to become pregnant during the study participation period
* Auto-immune disorder
* Enrolled in other experimental treatment study
